note: The old Power BI doc URL learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/admin/service-admin-setup-certification now 301-redirects to the Fabric-namespaced learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/admin/service-admin-setup-certification, confirming Microsoft has consolidated this content under Fabric branding rather than keeping a separate Power-BI-only page. Per that current doc, all Fabric items except Power BI dashboards can be certified; certification requires security groups (never individual named users) and can be delegated to domain admins. The 'Master Data' option visible in two of the screenshots is a separate, stricter endorsement tier not covered by this lesson (it's an even higher bar than Certified) — mentioned only briefly in the guide for accuracy since it appears in the real screenshots, not treated as a main topic.
